definitions.explanation: a line segment connecting two non-adjacent vertices of a polygon

examples.japanese: {正方形|せいほうけい}の{対角線|たいかくせん}を{引|ひ}く。
examples.english: To draw the diagonal of a square.

examples.japanese: {長方形|ちょうほうけい}の{対角線|たいかくせん}の{長|なが}さを{計算|けいさん}する。
examples.english: To calculate the length of the diagonal of a rectangle.

examples.japanese: {六角形|ろっかくけい}には{九本|きゅうほん}の{対角線|たいかくせん}がある。

notes:
{対角線|たいかくせん} is a line segment connecting two non-adjacent vertices (corners) of a polygon.

KANJI BREAKDOWN:
- {対|たい}: opposite, facing
- {角|かく}: angle, corner
- {線|せん}: line

MATHEMATICS:
The number of diagonals in a polygon with n sides is n(n-3)/2. For example, a square has 2 diagonals, a hexagon has 9.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {対角線|たいかくせん}を{引|ひ}く: to draw a diagonal
- {対角線|たいかくせん}の{長|なが}さ: length of a diagonal
- {対角線|たいかくせん}で{分|わ}ける: to divide by a diagonal

RELATED TERMS:
- {斜線|しゃせん}: diagonal/slanted line (general)
- {対角|たいかく}: diagonal; opposite corners
- {頂点|ちょうてん}: vertex
